mentions.name: IOC aggregator and search engine
mentions.description: This project collects IPs and other indicators of compromise (IOCs) from the operator's own servers and honeypots and aggregates them with well-known IPs and IOCs, with the goal of building a search engine over the resulting threat intelligence data. It is also a vehicle for learning Golang in a larger context.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am collecting IPs and other IOCs from some servers and honeypots that I have around and aggregating them with well known IPs and IOCs. I would like to create a sort of search engine for that.
